blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Aberdeen rose from 5 in June to 7 in September (+40.0%), and 4 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 1.2% of Abbotsford’s 572 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Aberdeen?
Aberdeen also had 25 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 7 condos and townhomes listed. The Aberdeen houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Aberdeen?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 7 condos and townhomes listed in Aberdeen. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Aberdeen a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Aberdeen had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Aberdeen from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in Aberdeen over those 4 months, out of 318 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
